title: Twelve, ii
logline: Wednesday. The walk to the beach, three panels wide. The dog makes it to the stairs' top and looks down. That's the walk now.

panels.composition: Three panels, each wider than a daily's usual. The alley to the beach road. WOOD and BARNABY, twelve, slow.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a wide panel of a thin man and an old dog walking slowly down an alley toward a beach road, no words

panels.composition: The top of the bluff stairs. The dog stopping. Looking down at the beach. Wood beside him, looking too.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a wide panel of an old dog and a thin man at the top of wooden bluff stairs looking down at a beach, no words

panels.composition: The two of them turning back. The beach unvisited. The strip fine with it.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a wide panel of a thin man and an old dog turning back from the top of a stairway, the beach below unvisited, no words

art.line: brush-pen; the flats cleaner; the Sundays the point now

notes: Three wide panels. The stairs' top is the beach now.
